sellPage.title: Sell Units | BetInsight Club
sellPage.heading: Sell Units
sellPage.intro: Create a sale offer using your earned or purchased Units. You choose the price within the permitted range.
sellPage.noticeTitle: Earned and purchased Units can be sold
sellPage.noticeCopy: Gift Units are completely excluded from both the sale amount and the sale fee. Make rechecks the wallet and Unit balance before every reservation.
sellPage.choose: Choose the amount and price per Unit.
sellPage.amountHelp: Choose a fixed amount between 10 and 100 Units.
sellPage.priceHelp: Payment will later be converted to USDT using the current exchange rate.
sellPage.initialCheck: Your balance and wallet are being checked. The button will be enabled automatically once everything is ready.
sellPage.rule1: The sale amount and sale fee may come from earned or purchased Units.
sellPage.rule2: Gift Units are not sold and cannot be used for the sale fee.
sellPage.rule3: Make rechecks the confirmed wallet, balance, amount and fee server-side.
sellPage.rule4: When reserving, free earned Units are used first, then earned Units on the tip account, and purchased Units last.
sellPage.rule5: Units reserved from the tip account are no longer available there for unlocking tips.
sellPage.rule6: The final USDT amount is calculated at the current exchange rate when payment is made.
sellPage.footer: BetInsight Unit Exchange · Sale Offer Version 1.5.0
sellPage.invalid: Invalid selection. Please choose a permitted sale amount and price.
sellPage.notEnough: Not possible: {{amount}} sale Units plus {{fee}} fee Units require {{required}} Units in total. {{available}} are available. {{missing}} Units are missing.
sellPage.walletRequired: Please set up and confirm your payout wallet first. The sale button will remain locked until then.
sellPage.ready: Wallet and balance are confirmed. You have {{available}} sellable Units and need {{required}} Units for this offer.
sellPage.checkFailed: The wallet and balance check could not be completed.
sellPage.accessCopy: Your personal dashboard access is missing. Please open this page from the Unit Exchange.
sellPage.balanceLoadFailed: The sellable balance could not be loaded securely. Please try again.
sellPage.accessMissingSecure: Secure dashboard access has not been loaded yet.
sellPage.reserving: Make is checking the wallet and balance again and reserving the Units. Please keep this page open.
sellPage.createFailed: The offer could not be created. Please check your wallet and balance.
sellPage.createdSuccess: Your sale offer was created and the Units were securely reserved.
sellPage.timeout: The check is taking too long. No automatic second attempt was triggered. Reload the balance before trying again.
